name: fanxie-wp-core
description: Fanxie WP Core — WordPress plugin. Repo-root tooling (wp-env, dev scripts). The Vue admin SPA lives under assets/admin/ with its own package.json.
author: Fanxie Lab

scripts.plugin:check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check fanxie-wp-core --format=table
scripts.plugin:check:json: wp-env run cli wp plugin check fanxie-wp-core --format=json
scripts.db:cli: wp-env run cli wp db cli
scripts.db:reset: wp-env run cli wp db reset --yes
